+def list_customers(conn: sqlite3.Connection, order: str | None = None) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:
+    sql = "SELECT id, name FROM customers"
+    if order == "name":
+        sql += " ORDER BY lower(name)"
+    elif order is not None:
+        sql += " ORDER BY " + order
+    else:
+        sql += " ORDER BY id"
+    return conn.execute(sql).fetchall()
